## Do not disclose this report publicly

Please stop here and follow [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md). Do **not** put
transaction hashes, exploit steps, secrets, or proof-of-concept code in a
public issue.

Use this template only as a routing marker if GitHub requires an issue entry.
The maintainer will close it and continue the report privately.
